4.column:
Devin takes Week 4 at 12–4 on the tiebreaker. He and Nate V both rode the Falcons, Atlanta hung 45 on the Saints, and the 69 total made Devin's 47 a lot less wrong than Nate's 38. Nate goes home 12–4 with nothing but the receipt. Dan, Peggy and Thom finished a game back at 11–5. The collapse belongs to Mike Sombloski, tied for the lead at 9–2 Sunday evening and 1–4 from there to finish 10–6. The dumbest pick goes to Jeff G, the only soul on the Dolphins, who scored ten. Twenty-two of you took the Bills against New England; Andy R took the Patriots alone and is insufferable today, deservedly.

Mrs. Sombloski wrote down 67 for the tiebreaker. Six seven. The game landed on 69, two off, the closest guess in the room, attached to a sheet with six picks on it. Respect the bit.

5.column:
Ryan Holovics wins Week 5 at 12–2 and takes the $95 pot. He clinched it Sunday, then celebrated by taking the Rams on Monday; Buffalo won 37–34 in overtime, so even the champ leaves with a fresh bruise. Tom finishes alone in second at 11–3, close enough to smell the money, far enough to get none of it. The commissioner sits in a nine-way pileup at 10–4, bonnet still on.

The collapse belongs to Walczyk: 4–10, tied for dead last with the house, and the house was picking with a coin. Dumbest pick goes to Leah and Mrs. Sombloski, the only two on the Titans, who scored three points. Mike Sombloski went 10–4; Mrs. Sombloski went 6–8 and lost the feud by four. Derek asked everyone to root for Ariel not to finish last. She went 8–6, nowhere near it. The Monday total landed on 71, and Nate V's 69 was closest in the room, which bought him exactly nothing.

6.column:
One game in and the board already looks like a crime scene. Josh and the commissioner took Denver 17–14 in overtime and sit alone at 1–0. The other nineteen humans are 0–1, and so is the house, which Walczyk would enjoy more if Walczyk hadn't ridden the same horse.

Ryan, the defending champ, is chasing from the jump. Derek's "this is my week" is now one loss old. London kicks off Sunday at 9:30 a.m.; dig out or dig deeper.
